standard_prerequisites.use: Provide (V, v_0) -> (Y, y_0) and lift the specialization y -> y_0 into V.

core_obligations: Statements (1) and (2): by etale localization reduce to the scheme case and import the corresponding scheme lemma.
Statement (3), if direction: Y -> X is surjective because A -> A^ is faithfully flat, so regularity of Y implies regularity of X by statement (1).

Statement (3), only-if direction: X regular makes the henselian local rings of Y regular at all points of the special fibre; for a general point y use that |Y| -> |Spec(A^)| is closed in the proper case to find a specialization y -> y_0 landing in the closed fibre.
Choose an elementary etale neighbourhood (V, v_0) -> (Y, y_0), lift the specialization to v -> v_0 in V via the decency lemma, and conclude O_{V,v} is a localization of O_{V,v_0}, hence regular.
proof_roadmap: Etale localization of (1) and (2); surjectivity for the if direction; closedness of the specializing map; specialization lifting through the etale neighbourhood; localization of regular local rings.
difficulty_reason: The substantive step is the general-point argument in (3): producing the specialization into the closed fibre and lifting it through an elementary etale neighbourhood so regularity propagates from the fibre.
